نقتني (form VIII)
# نَقْتَنِي (naqtanī) /naq.ta.niː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَنَى (iqtanā)
# نَقْتَنِيَ (naqtaniya) /naq.ta.ni.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَنَى (iqtanā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
